description: Retrieve a signed, non-binding recommendation of verification-call cost from memory. Returns JSON hint; 402 list price unchanged. Compliance: GDPR Art. 5. Cost $0.01 per call.

context_signature.description: Optional unused field reserved for a future composed context signature.

entity_id.description: Entity the recommendation is scoped to.

owner_wallet.description: 0x-prefixed owner wallet. Signature must recover to this address.

tool_name.description: Live verification tool to price, e.g. 'verify_biodiversity'.

wallet_signature.description: EIP-191 signature over the pricing-hint message.

name: memory.pricing_hint

outputSchema.description: Signed, non-binding price recommendation. Never ciphertext.

binding.description: Always false. Does not change any 402.

hint_hash.description: SHA-256 of the canonical hint body.

ok.description: True when the tool completed without a validation error.

owner_wallet.description: Wallet the hint was issued to.

payment.description: Settlement receipt after x402 or sandbox payment.

tool.description: Tool name that produced this payload.

title: Memory Pricing Hint
